outcome: PPCM clinical outcomes (cardiogenic shock, respiratory failure, acute renal failure, thromboembolism, all-cause mortality, cardiac recovery)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 30 Asian women diagnosed with PPCM who delivered at public hospitals in Hong Kong between 2013 and 2022.
finding: Antenatal anaemia and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy were significantly associated with higher odds of PPCM, which had an incidence of 1 in 11,179 live births and a 60% cardiac recovery rate at 12 months.
followup_time: At least 12 months for primary cardiac outcomes, with some women followed longer for subsequent pregnancies.
